svg.text: Katran — block diagram (S103 P5 tree: cores A/B, stereo rotation, bipolar width)

Every block runs every 32-sample render block (constant CPU). Per-block laws are blue; per-sample audio is black. Yellow pills are rows (short label · key · range). Red ! = review flag (see KATRAN_BLOCK_DIAGRAM_SVG.md §6).
OSC A f = note + coa + fin (platform pitch rows,
x LFO/velocity multiplier on coa: modNodeValue)
OSC B f = OSC A's pitch + (bCoarse − 48) + bFine/63×0.5 st
+ patch-LFO cv·lfl·0.3 st (! lfl applied twice)
Table forms capped 0.45 fs (core B copy: 0.45 fs/2)
OSC B — ring modulator (full rate, 1 copy)
Form = shared typ / wav (wav: Saw Rec Tri Sin; pwm: Tri warp,
Saw/Rec two-read pulse; wtb: frame) — or ARENA if src = B / AB
pos sets pwm width / wtb frame / arena window (+ cv·lfl·24 steps)
Output B[n] (int16), LSB = 1 on the sample its phase wraps
Row / frame / window change only at a cycle start
OSC A — the exciter (one copy per core)
Core A copy: full rate, inc = f / ratio, pos − dtn·16
Core B copy: half rate (16 smp/block), f × ratio, pos + dtn·16
ratio = 2^(dtn'² × 25 cents) — dtn moves detune AND pos spread
Hard sync: reset when (D_core + 0.5·32767·wrapB) crosses th upward
Same forms as OSC B; ARENA if src = A / AB
Selected by src: off / A / B / AB (replaces typ for that osc)
S = pos × (N − 1024)/127, taken at the osc's next cycle start
Speed = the pitch: root note, coa 0 → 1 smp/smp (43 Hz); unclamped
→ damp 1-pole LP (dmp) → guard (peak/8 smp → ≤ 0.7 FS) → SSAT16
! dmp: 0 = open, 1 = 20 Hz … 127 = 300 Hz (jump, darkest at 1)
core A: 1 read/sample; core B: 1 read/half-rate sample
Mixed into the exciter by nse (crossfade with OSC A)
Any trigger (step, pad, MIDI, chromatic): kE = velocity,
decays −60 dB in 80 ms; re-arms the run gain gr (5 ms)
burst = min(1, 2·kik'): exc += burst·kE·0.8, nse += burst·kE·0.5
gr: run 127 = on (20 ms rise); 0..126 = decay 0.25 s .. 60 s
transport stop decays at T(126) = 60 s even at run 127
feedback loop: ring write → delay read (a comb at T)
spr · kat_spread (bipolar: <63 xfb to 0.6, >63 T ±12 %, F1 ±12 st)
CORE B (half rate at fs/2, output ×2 interp.)
feedback loop: ring write → delay read (a comb at T)
spr · kat_spread (bipolar: <63 xfb to 0.6, >63 T ±12 %, F1 ±12 st)
Core B differs: delay time and dry tap in half-rate samples (same comb pitch), F1 at fs/2 (ceiling 8.1 kHz), F2 coefficient k(2−k),
OSC B read at 2n, core A's D decimated (core A reads core B's D held), its own noise read.
buf → OSC A (src A/AB), OSC B (src B/AB)
a = core A, b = core B; one-pole,
L = buf, R = right[] → the slot's stereo
◀ rot, CE1 (dp1), wid feed the matrix
◀ CE2 (dp2) feeds F3 and both F1
MODULATORS (per block) — their destinations are written into the blocks above
rate = lfr (0.02..20 Hz log) × 2^(lfm·(1.5·ringPrev + inv) + jitter)
ringPrev = mean |D| of both cores (the loop's level)
jitter: chs × 0.1 oct, redrawn each LFO cycle
destinations ×lfl AGAIN (depth ∝ lfl²): OSC B pos +cv·lfl·24,
OSC B fine +cv·lfl·0.3 st, F1 +cv·lfl·12 st, tube +0.15·cv·lfl, fb +0.2·inv·lfl
destinations ×lfl once: VCA g1 offset .42 + cv, g2 offset .42 + inv; own rate
cycle: cy 10 ms .. 60 s log; never reset by triggers
skew sk: rise share of the cycle (each stage ≥ 3 blocks)
chs > 64: rise hurried by the loop level (ringPrev)
CE1 → output level: 1 − dp1 + dp1·CE1 (stereo matrix)
CE2 → F1 ±48 st × dp2 (bipolar), F3 ±24 st × dp2
core B: T / 2 in half-rate samples
LFO page (unchanged): rate, sync, wave, offset,
Velocity: dst / amt → one row; velocity also
Morph, step automation, MIDI: every row flagged
The source patch (AIRA Modular, TORCIDO_Noise_Synth) — numbered controls ↔ Katran rows
t1 = TORCIDO ch 1 out of each core
r → both outputs (+AMP1); ringPrev → LFO rate (lfm)
OSC B coa (kat_b_coarse, range+coarse in one row)
OSC B fin (kat_b_fine) + LFO inv·lfl·0.3 st
OSC B wrap → OSC A sync (weight P = 0.5, fixed)
GRF2 → OSC B coa, and dtk (delay follows)
cv, inv → see Patch LFO box
bal (kat_vca) → g2: core A = ring + g2·loop
snc (kat_sync): threshold on D + SQR wrap
core A (AMP2 side) — now rotated by rot / wid
core B (AMP1 side) — now rotated by rot / wid
Katran additions with no patch control
run, kik (run / kick) · cy1 sk1 dp1 cy2 sk2 dp2, chs (chaos envelopes) · src, dmp (buffer read) · noi (noise exciter)
dtn (A detune + pos spread) · wow (delay drift) · spr (core coupling / spread) · dtk (delay tracks OSC B) · res, typ (F1)
lct (F2 loop low-cut) · cut (F3 output tilt) · wid (bipolar width) · rot (stereo rotation) · vol, pan, lfo_*, velo_mod_*
Second core (B): half rate, its own OSC A copy (detuned), its own delay ring and loop — the patch had one loop.
Fixed by design (no row): LV1/LV2, AMP offsets 0.42, the delay dry/wet 50/50, sync weight P 0.5, kick decay 80 ms,
burst targets (0.8 exc, 0.5 nse, 0.3 fb), tube = 0.25·drv, output norm 0.5, guard 0.7, DC block 10 Hz.
1 Patch-LFO depth lfl is applied twice for 5 of its 7 destinations (cv already contains lfl): depth ∝ lfl²; at init (51) ≈ 0.16 of full.
2 src (off/A/B/AB) is a separate selector; a 'buf' oscillator type would be clearer — needs a per-oscillator type for 'one or both'.
3 dmp: 0 = open, 1 = 20 Hz low-pass, 127 = 300 Hz — the darkest setting is next to 'open', and the top is still dark.
4 OSC B coarse spans −48..+79 semitones (bCoarse − 48), far wider than useful; the plan said −36..+24.
5 The transport-stop decay uses T(126) = 60 s, so stopping lets the drone ring for about a minute.
6 dtn couples A's detune (to ±25 cents, squared law) and its pos spread (±16 steps): two effects on one knob.
7 CE2 moves F1 by ±48 semitones at full depth — four octaves; most of the range is extreme.
8 bal (vca) mixes two products with 0.42 offsets; its centre is the patch balance, but its ends are not obvious levers.
9 Several fixed laws hide levers the patch had (AMP offsets, TORCIDO levels, delay dry/wet, tube vs drive).
10 Page order: OSC A's controls on osc, OSC B and the exciter on fm, the patch LFO on mod, the delay on click, the
loop filter on filter, run/kick + both CEs on aeg — the signal chain is split across six pages.
Labels: short label · key. Ranges are the code's laws (KatranVoice.c, KatranTables.c, S103 P5 tree).
